allow_instructions: Read-only repository inspection, git status/diff/log, npm test, npm run check, npm run build:extension, and WebQA health checks are normal development actions for this repository.

Read-only WebQA diagnostic inspection with the exact tools webqa_latest_diagnostic, webqa_diagnostic_section, and webqa_read_report_bug is a normal development action when a sanitized Report Bug JSON already exists under qa-runs/. These tools do not scan sites, mutate the repository, or read arbitrary files.

When AutoQA is enabled (.autoqa/state.json enabled=true), bounded dogfood of URLs already listed in qa-sites corpus files (golden.json, rotating.json, adversarial.json, discoveries.json) and local AutoQA fixture origins is authorized without per-site approval. Corpus membership is intentional authorization.

AutoQA dogfood launches installed Google Chrome with the unpacked dist/extension. Playwright bundled Chromium is not required. Missing bundled Chromium is not an AutoQA blocker when Google Chrome is installed.
block_instructions: Require review before browser automation or scans of origins that are NOT listed in AutoQA corpus files (qa-sites/golden.json, rotating.json, adversarial.json, discoveries.json) and are not local AutoQA fixture origins — unless the user explicitly requested that specific origin.
Require review before git push, force push, reset --hard, git clean, destructive checkout/restore, or any command that could discard work.
Require review before SSH, production deployment, Docker restart/up/down on remote systems, or any production write operation.
Require review before modifying, printing, copying, or transmitting .env files, credentials, API keys, browser authentication tokens, or other secrets.
Require review before deleting files outside generated build output or qa-runs.
